comparisons.overview: An explicit ordered field agrees with both small seed operators. Their agreement gives a normalized all-degree homotopy on the noncritical marked source. The critical state frame, the covariant corner obstruction and the independent physical products have different targets.

comparisons.title: The ordinary unit at nonrational and rational levels
comparisons.overview: How many positive-weight steps can survive inside one affine linkage block? The upper bound and a longest surviving word give a sharp answer. Inflated units transfer across that finite tower. At rational shift the same quotient has infinite exponent, while particular original units can still be invertible.

comparisons.title: The original-base algebra of words and modes
comparisons.overview: Supported word counits and the full normal flip give an algebraic shuffle integral on every surjection. Its degree-zero map can be computed before any global Ran construction.

comparisons.title: Divided determinants, mixed commutators and proper image
comparisons.overview: The scalar vacuum quotient, two half determinants and intrinsic mixed relation are separate premises of the rank-two map. The two-point diagonal pole measures its proper image even before testing a state representation.

comparisons.title: What Ising spin exchange determines
comparisons.overview: The projected finite-base tensor retains the full algebra of spin intertwiners. Absolute marked exchange distinguishes the mirror orientations. An independently normalized sesquilinear four-point gluing adds state data. Logarithmic endpoints require their own topology and categories.

comparisons.title: Hall multiplication and untraced compact information
comparisons.overview: Finite-root Hall exactness addresses the polynomial one-loop multiplication. The oriented flag asks for a covariant map on the full supported coefficient. A separate compact calculation measures precisely which first-order cubic information the fibre row and traces lose. In the integrable zero-scalar stratum the nilpotence length of the middle product depends on the Witt index of its fixed form. Every inserted positive-genus scalar there equals its section value. Off that stratum, point and three-middle-state readings on the torus determine the product.

comparisons.title: Weil sign tests, spectral width and modular sections
comparisons.overview: Whole-window positivity and a fixed infinite family use every term of the Weil functional. An annulus in the native translation spectrum detects an obstruction to unitarity on its own width. Genus-two determinant and all-genus lattice-gluing comparisons specify their lines and normalizations independently.

comparisons.title: An independent composite as the next field input
comparisons.overview: Independent input bars and finite spectator rank carry the three- and four-pole current evaluations. Integral one-exterior cones test unprojected jets. In analytic sewing a received image topology and a vacuum component impose separate conditions.

comparisons.title: Algebraic source calculations with their physical recipients
comparisons.overview: Finite exterior sources compute the ordinary mapping spaces. Four simple spectator bounds also give an all-mark compatibility theorem. Both calculations have a specified source, unlike the remaining genuine Heisenberg recognition problem.

comparisons.title: Bounded tests on the original state or coefficient complex
comparisons.overview: The exceptional \(W_4\) vacuum has two length-one torsion summands in its polynomial family. A ghost-spin bound on rational cocycles gives \(\eta_7u=0\) at \(k+4=3/2\), and reciprocal and complementary duality give the other three exceptional fibres. Cubic jets, elliptic contacts, the M2 square and separated M5 surfaces each distinguish a named operation before its proposed physical identification.

comparisons.title: Cotangent Yangian cuts, collisions and exchange
comparisons.overview: Ordered spectral cuts preserve every vertex product. The ordinary Zhu algebra identifies states whose fields have different poles, and the sphere block algebra depends on the coordinate action. A meromorphic exchange on field modules must intertwine the two orders of the cut and satisfy the field hexagons.

comparisons.title: Mini-twistor defect fusion and flat celestial currents
comparisons.overview: Framed scattering gives the classical dressing rule. The bosonic cotangent orbit has a fixed-point double pole. Additional tangent fermions and an ordered source give the rank-two current contacts and their ordered fusion. Polar fluxes give the abelian vertex bialgebra under different boundary conditions. The flat four-dimensional WZW jets retain their crossed quadratic residue.

comparisons.title: Yangian products on words and on fields
comparisons.overview: An adjacent collision multiplies two states in the ordinary Yangian. A rational vacuum field also has poles, and its exchange can depend on the charges of the inputs. A coproduct on either construction must carry these operations to its specified tensor at the same positions.

readingPaths.title: Four charged lines, from braid character to point attachment
readingPaths.summary: The Gaussian calculation fixes the separated character. Its four-point link shows why the datum needed to reconstruct a collision is an arrow into that link.

stages.label: A physical coefficient and a geometric link
stages.description: The charged intertwiner specifies a rank-one local system. Independent link calculations test its commuting cluster twists and the clean angular cohomology.

stages.label: Only the deepest cluster survives
stages.description: At level two, none of the proper partitions of four unit charges has a surviving link. The ordinary deepest comparison has rank two in each of degrees two and three.

stages.label: Different extensions have identical dimensions
stages.description: Quotienting the perverse extension by a line in its two-dimensional point subobject gives pairwise distinct coefficients indexed by \(\mathbb P^1\).

stages.label: Impose the marked permutation action
stages.description: The positive half-exchange is \(+i\) on the open. At the origin \(S_4\) acts on the candidate lines through the trivial and sign characters.

stages.label: Test the ordinary coarse quotient
stages.description: The ordinary pullback counit tests stabilizer invariants and selects the trivial line. A physical use of that selection requires the coarse-pullback hypothesis.

stages.label: Recover the arrow at the point
stages.description: The physical collision must specify which attachment is realized. Once it is given, the open–closed pullback reconstructs the sheaf at this gluing step.

readingPaths.title: A bulk insertion distinguishes two independently prepared disk states
readingPaths.summary: A compact interior cochain and a harmonic disk with a specified probability law meet on finite polynomial boundary states. The measured mixed coefficient survives a collar.

stages.label: Construct the supported operator and the disk law
stages.description: The interior contraction differentiates \(p_j\) on the annulus. Independently, the disk action sets \(\mathbb E|Z_n|^2=n\) and the Mehler eigenvalue \(q^E\).

stages.label: Measure a correlation invisible to individual modes
stages.description: The finite states \((p_1^2\pm p_2)/2\) have the same single-mode marginals. Their mixed moments are \(\pm2\), with one-sided collar pairings \(\pm2q^2\).

readingPaths.title: A neutral pair of bulk rays prepares a sourced disk law
readingPaths.summary: The native ray and the harmonic action specify a state in two independent ways. Their normalized laws and real-collar matrix elements can be compared exactly.

stages.label: Prepare the two inputs independently
stages.description: Use the framed Wilson ray with its fixed propagator, and the zero-mode-fixed harmonic disk with its own Dirichlet action.

stages.label: Compare the coherent state with the linear source
stages.description: The neutral pair at radius \(r\) has a regulator scalar before normalization. Completion of the square in the disk law gives means \(ar^n\) and the same normalized collar pairing.

readingPaths.title: From the two ordered seed fields to all marked degrees
readingPaths.summary: The trace factor and Laurent bounds enter at different steps of the comparison. The last stage identifies the operation an independent physical construction must supply.

stages.label: Fix the seed fields
stages.description: Keep the shifted derivative and each trace spectator in the two nontrace seed identities.

stages.label: Contract the discrepancy
stages.description: Agreement on the image of the small complex supplies a normalized Hom primitive in every rooted degree.

stages.label: Evaluate the whole marked series
stages.description: One ghost cutoff and finite right support across a series make each output coefficient finite. Both positive-inserted maps are part of the prescription.

stages.label: Identify a physical adjunction and products
stages.description: The two boundary categories must supply both adjunction triangles, the ordered products and the tensorator on the specified supported inputs.

readingPaths.title: From finite affine linkage to the unbounded ordinary unit
readingPaths.summary: Each positive step in a tensor word uses up part of a finite root-length bound. The actual inflated unit then passes along a finite tower to completely unbounded sources.

stages.label: Follow a tensor word inside its affine block
stages.description: The nonrational integral roots form a finite reflection subsystem. Horizontal Vermas detect the actual bimodule words and force every surviving positive step forward.

stages.label: Bound the length of a nonzero word
stages.description: The \((1+|\Phi^+|)\)th derived tensor power vanishes.

stages.label: Transfer the original unit to the full source
stages.description: The split augmentation gives a finite tower of inflated factors, on which the actual right action and cofree realization already identify the unit. The resulting image is \(\operatorname{Loc}(W)\).

stages.label: Which torsion complexes belong to the image?
stages.description: For positive-current \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), a common tail in sufficiently low cohomological degrees forces cellularity when all cohomology is jointly augmentation-torsion. A nonzero jointly torsion-cohomology object orthogonal to all shifted trivial cells would settle the unrestricted question negatively.

readingPaths.title: From rational exchange to the degree-zero mode algebra
readingPaths.summary: Rerooting a pole changes its Taylor expansion against a spectator. Keeping those coefficients makes the finite algebraic integral possible on the original base.

stages.label: Transport the pole and form the word diagram
stages.description: The full principal-part flip and its support counits assemble the contravariant finite-word diagram with the external shuffle product.

stages.label: Identify the actual mode quotient
stages.description: The singleton map extends through whole-complex relation homotopies and induces the intrinsic degree-zero algebra map.

stages.label: Compare a global field operation
stages.description: A proper-support or Ran de Rham realization has an independent geometric recipient and attaching maps.

readingPaths.title: Four inputs for the rank-two intrinsic RTT map
readingPaths.summary: The determinant calculation and mixed Laurent commutator test relations inside the intrinsic quotient. The vacuum filtration and a diagonal pole decide injectivity and generation there.

stages.label: Normalize and test the relations
stages.description: Vacuum regularity, the classical current embedding, both determinants and the mixed commutator each supply a different input.

stages.label: Read the image in the mode algebra
stages.description: The prescribed rank-two divided generators define an injective algebra map through \(\hbar^2=0\). The diagonal-pole class stays outside its image.

readingPaths.title: From K3 trace ambiguity to a separating family of measurements
readingPaths.summary: Choosing a marking makes the compact and finite-Gaussian measurement maps comparable on an explicitly known kernel.

stages.label: Compute the kernel and specify independent test laws
stages.description: The fibre row and all correction traces miss 1,750 compact cubics. Null insertions distinguish them, and a finite positive Gaussian tilt realizes any real third cumulant while preserving its covariance.

stages.label: Identify the two measurement maps
stages.description: Identify the middle coordinates with the whitened probes. The two cubic expectations recover the marked row and contraction exactly at nonzero tilt.

readingPaths.title: Which data would identify an independent dual theory?
readingPaths.summary: These problems compare independently defined objects. Each stage gives a result on one side and an observable, unit or attaching map that a proposed identification must still transport.

stages.label: Keep the marked collision
stages.description: Connected bar–cobar reconstruction is aritywise. Independently constructed fields must also select the attachment at the deepest collision, even for four abelian rays.

stages.label: Produce the physical field operations
stages.description: The noncritical all-degree marked homotopy uses the prescribed positive-inserted maps. A genuinely covariant two-bulk-input lift already encounters the marked current obstruction.

stages.label: Feed the output of a collision into a second collision
stages.description: The two separately resolved pairs have an algebraic four-pole evaluation. The unprojected integral cone and analytic image Gram bounds test different aspects of closure.

stages.label: Test an independently defined action on arbitrary objects
stages.description: Ordinary finite exterior maps, the two genuine actor conditions and the affine torsion-image question require different categories and marks.

stages.label: Compare the oriented operation before tracing
stages.description: Polynomial one-loop exactness preserves regular fields. An oriented critical coefficient must give a supported full-flag operation before proper pushforward.

stages.label: Distinguish two states with a prepared probe
stages.description: The harmonic disk supplies an independent positive example. A gravitational cap must also carry its cut cycle, reference state, phase and higher connected measurements.

readingPaths.title: Three independent arithmetic comparisons
readingPaths.summary: Translation, local normal derivatives and the modular section are tested in different spaces. Their constants and domains let one tell what is actually reconstructed.

stages.label: The wider arithmetic Hilbert space
stages.description: The native translation has a full spectral annulus on the wider quotient. The proper dense inclusion cannot identify it isometrically with the narrower quotient.

stages.label: The complete Weil functional
stages.description: Each vector in a fixed window and every member of an infinite translation sequence are different quantifiers. Eventual positivity of the specified sequence would decide the global question.

stages.label: Integral coefficients and modular sections
stages.description: A modulo-prime-square derivative detects geometric information lost by point values. On smooth genus-two Jacobians a determinant calculation fixes the Igusa section and its sign in a specified frame.

readingPaths.title: Tests for recognizing actions and composing physical operations
readingPaths.summary: An original comparison is fixed by its source, its recipient, and the operations carried between them. Each stage pairs a constructed calculation with an input that still distinguishes proposed extensions.

stages.label: Pointed actions and genuine roofs
stages.description: For arbitrary pointed coassociative actors, test a four-block homotopy through a root change outside the recognized families. For the rank-one Heisenberg fibre the independent test is connectedness of the entire detector-zero sector and contractibility of its marked automorphism space.

stages.label: Ordinary induction and cellular generation
stages.description: At nonrational level the ordinary unit already gives the generated image. For positive-current \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), a common tail in sufficiently low cohomology gives cellularity when all cohomology is jointly torsion. The unrestricted equality remains open. At rational shift the split weight-zero fibre cannot decide the ordinary unit.

stages.label: Pair-first horizontal and analytic sewing
stages.description: Compare both integral ternary iterations before occupied projection, retaining the odd elementary divisors of the one-exterior head. On independently received Virasoro composites, compare the two vacuum rootings with all meromorphic terms and a common graph-norm stage.

stages.label: Geometric Heisenberg endpoints
stages.description: The opposed Jordan charges test information lost by all finite jets. A proposed geometric endpoint functor must also take the incoming and outgoing cap maps to the polynomial relative bar on their actual common domain.

stages.label: Mixed spacetime and relative elliptic products
stages.description: The two-label Ward class survives a marked normal derivative. Extend its supported operation through the other contacts and a contracting current spectator. For the elliptic cubic compare both orders on the full prism, retaining source differential, old cylinder and the independent compact unit.

stages.label: Nonlinear and intrinsic quantum fields
stages.description: Test the polarized counit on the nonzero module invisible to the exceptional vacuum. For the divided rational modes, compare the mixed residues of the prescribed Cauchy lifts and the two successive rank-two corrections. At nonzero level the next questions are a higher-rank correction modulo \(\hbar^3\) and a rank-two lift satisfying all RTT relations modulo \(\hbar^4\).

readingPaths.title: From geometric coefficients to independent fields and states
readingPaths.summary: Each hypothesis about a global recipient has an observable consequence before integration or trace. The scalar normalization, geometry of the support and order of a collision can each change that consequence.

stages.label: Geometric integration and the oriented Hall operation
stages.description: Finite rational word integration gives the mode quotient. An independent Ran construction must recover its supported product. Compare the universal cubic pole on the charge-two Hall flag before proper pushforward and preserve the odd directions through both orders.

stages.label: Compact orientation and state preparation
stages.description: Use the shared elliptic translation torsor in both compact charts. Compare an independently prepared section state on all 24 cohomology classes, including its untraced cubic and a null test invisible to the fibre row.

stages.label: Brane junctions and higher currents
stages.description: The polynomial M2 square has a primitive whose spatial jets cannot be uniformly bounded. A physical derived junction must compare the two actual flux insertions with that primitive. D3 torsion, a separated M5 Miura derivative and the calibrated higher-current normal residue supply other operation-sensitive tests.

stages.label: Mixed strings and gravity
stages.description: A regulated oscillator wheel has two opposite signed orders. A physical string amplitude needs their independently computed graph weights. For the gravity cap the cut quartet must reproduce its independent preparation and higher stress measurements on the stated cycle.

stages.label: Arithmetic coefficients and positivity
stages.description: Compare the integral normal derivative and the actual local-field operations on a common trace domain with their Frobenius variance. For the full Weil functional the untouched infinite sign tail is decisive. A modular section with fixed sign on smooth Jacobians has a different comparison to compact Hall preparation.

readingPaths.title: From the source to an actual field value
readingPaths.summary: Read the source definition and uniform bounds before the evaluation. Then inspect the retained values and the coefficient-restriction counterexample before turning to the stronger physical comparison.

stages.label: An intrinsic ordered rooted carrier
stages.description: For every numerical \(K\) over \(R_3\), the ordered source \(N^{1-n}=\varprojlim_R\operatorname*{colim}_L(\operatorname{Hom}_{R_3}((G/J_L)^n,A)\otimes_{R_3,\mathrm{alg}}A_R)\) is a continuous dg bimodule over the full smooth native algebra \(A\). Both completed endpoint actions, translation and the scalar chain augmentation are defined. Finite expressions have a canonical dense map into this carrier.

stages.label: A global Cartan isomorphism with uniform Laurent bounds
stages.description: At every numerical \(K\) over \(R_3\), the restricted Laurent source has an actual continuous Cartan operator \(T=\lim_M T_M\). Its composition \(T^2\) defines strict inverse frame maps \(\Gamma^{\pm1}=1\pm\hbar T+\tfrac12\hbar^2T^2\). The resolved differential is the limit of the prescribed native rows and equals \(\Gamma d_{\rm ten}\Gamma^{-1}\). Both total and relative translation commute with the global frame map.

stages.label: Pure-root values extend to the ordered completion
stages.description: At each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\) over \(R_3\), the chosen finite pure-root evaluation extends uniquely and continuously to every rooted degree of the ordered carrier. The extension is a dg full-\(A\)-bimodule map, preserves both Ward laws and all prescribed scalar, first-root and native quadratic values, and retains the full algebraic trace factors. Its restricted Laurent version has finite coefficient convolution; the global source theorem supplies its chain and total-translation domain conditions.

stages.label: A marked evaluation on the completed ordered source
stages.description: At each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\) over \(R_3\), \(\mathcal E_{\rm ten}=\mathcal P+\mathcal J+\Xi\), with \(\Xi=d_Q\mathcal H+\mathcal H d_{\rm ten}\), is an actual continuous dg bimodule evaluation for the full smooth native algebra. It is defined on every homogeneous element of the ordered polynomial marked carrier and its specified restricted Laurent extension. It has both coefficient-indexed Ward laws and transports through the finite and global Cartan isomorphisms.

stages.label: The evaluation keeps the field and its fixed normalizations
stages.description: For the checked noncritical \(R_3\) marked evaluation, the scalar value is the whole field, and every prescribed first-root homotopy and the full native \(q_\hbar\) column survive. The classical oriented \(H[1]\wedge H[-1]\) value on \(q\) is \(4/u\). Positive inserted cycles take \(q_\hbar\) to \(-\mathrm{id}\) and \(\omega_\hbar\) to \(+\mathrm{id}\). The inserted Casimir and first mixed values retain their prescribed native terms and trace phases.

stages.label: Literal coefficient restriction does not give the evaluation
stages.description: The direct marked evaluation differs from \(\epsilon_C\alpha_{\rm tr}\). For the signed trace root \(r_{I,0}^{\rm Ch}=-r_{c^I_{-1}}^{\rm raw}\) with unit endpoints, their values on the same finite-frame source and trace-ghost test are \(-\mathrm{id}\) and zero. A raw singleton would give \(+\mathrm{id}\), so the sign convention matters. Agreement on scalar and ghost-free trace-current states does not supply a factorization.

stages.label: From the first root to every rooted degree
stages.description: The scalar and first-root values are the initial restrictions. Equality on the two small seed states, including every trace spectator, makes the normalized retained class vanish in every middle degree. The whole-series continuation uses the prescribed positive-inserted maps.

stages.label: The stronger physical and operation comparison
stages.description: The remaining physical target is to identify the checked carrier and evaluation with the prescribed full marked right adjoint, impose its full \(R_2\) and unit-relative normalization, and compare native ordered products, supported residues, collisions and tensorators on the required domains. Full right-dual and merged-mode completion, coefficient biduality, completed bar/cobar comparison and compatible higher precision require separate constructions.

readingPaths.note: This is an editorial reading route. Only the separately listed source-supported edges assert mathematical dependencies.

readingPaths.title: From state obstructions to the limits of completion
readingPaths.summary: Begin with the state retract and the relative Ward tests. Compare the all-level canonical residual and critical quadratic result, then examine why a finite coefficient diagram need not admit an ordinary-limit value.

stages.label: The noncritical native state complex has a small retract
stages.description: At each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\) over \(R_3\), the actual states \(1,q_\hbar,\omega_\hbar\), with \(dq_\hbar=2T\omega_\hbar\), sit in a translation-linear strong deformation retract retaining all trace-current polynomials and trace ghosts. Ordinary state cohomology is \((R_3\mathbf1\oplus R_3[\omega_\hbar])\otimes L\), with no extra \(\hbar\)-torsion. Precomposition gives the corresponding shifted-Hom dg bimodule retract.

stages.label: Relative Ward cohomology retains the full trace factor
stages.description: At fixed \(K\ne-2\), let \(\mathcal Z_p=\ker(\partial_u-(-)T_L)\) on \(\operatorname{Hom}_{R_3}(L^p,\mathcal E)\), with \(\mathcal Z_p=0\) for \(p<0\) and \(\mathcal E=\operatorname{Hom}_{R_3}(V,V((u)))\). Then \(H^m(Q_{\rm rel})\cong\mathcal Z_{1-m}\oplus\mathcal Z_{-2-m}\oplus\delta_{m,-1}\mathcal E_{\rm const}\). Only the scalar trace state contributes the separate \(q_\hbar\)-residue obstruction.

stages.label: A conditional test for relative Ward primitives
stages.description: An already defined closed relative-Ward forcing of degree \(-1\) has a relative-Ward primitive precisely when its value on \(1\otimes L^2\) and its scalar-trace residue on \(q_\hbar\otimes1\) vanish. In degree \(-2\), the tests are its values on \(1\otimes L^3\) and \(\omega_\hbar\otimes L^0\); there is no additional residue test on every trace state. Ordinary exactness is weaker: the difference between the prescribed classical \(4/u\) quadratic value and the contraction primitive has residue \(4\,\mathrm{id}\) and is not a relative-Ward boundary.

stages.label: The coupled canonical quadratic/cubic residual is solved
stages.description: The native operators satisfy \(\mathscr D Z_q=2\partial_u Z_\omega\) and \(\mathscr D Z_\omega=0\). The coupled fixed-frame residual equations have explicit solutions at every numerical level, including zero and critical level, on the declared finite-composition domain and its separating smooth structural coefficient hull. The source gauges retain the prescribed first term and the mixed second-order term with coefficient one; both Ward laws and strict rooted units hold.

stages.label: Critical quadratic primitives exist at all algebraic weights
stages.description: At \(K=-2\), every actual signed quadratic pure-root forcing with the prescribed first homotopies annihilates every algebraic native degree-one cycle. It therefore has an individual ordinary \(R_3\)-linear primitive with the stated pointwise Laurent bound, in every algebraic weight. The all-weight classical generation theorem and the full trace factor are included.

stages.label: Finite projected coefficients form a valid prodiagram
stages.description: For every numerical \(K\) over \(R_3\), the normalized finite free closed complexes with basis \(u^te j_t\), \(0\le t<T\), have actual images \(u^t(1\otimes X_H(-t-1))e\) in the checked carrier. The projections commute with right-quotient transitions and truncation of the nonnegative Laurent coefficients below exponent \(T\).

stages.label: The ordinary inverse limit exceeds finite right support
stages.description: The finite projection has no coefficient-preserving ordinary-inverse-limit value in the checked global carrier. Its required series has infinitely many independent right PBW coordinates already at the first right quotient modulo \(\hbar\), while that carrier requires finite right support across the whole series. The witness has fixed word length, degree and conformal weight, Laurent floor zero and a common scalar middle cutoff. Its scalar-vacuum state series is nevertheless a legitimate Laurent series.

stages.label: A common ghost cutoff is necessary for these extensions
stages.description: Coefficientwise membership in the ordered source is insufficient for its Laurent extension. If the ghost cutoff may grow with the exponent, the explicit Cartan example has a retained coefficient proportional to \(M-1\), and the pure trace-root example has evaluation coefficient \(-(M+1)u^{-1}\). Allowing a separate Laurent pole bound at each ghost coordinate also defeats the pure contraction. These arrays lie outside the checked uniform domain.

readingPaths.note: This is an editorial reading route, not a claimed chain of mathematical implications.

readingPaths.title: From actual currents to comparison maps
readingPaths.summary: Follow three concrete constructions and inspect the source and recipient of each. This is an editorial reading order, not a claim that the three branches depend on one another.

stages.label: Current images, marked differentials and heights
stages.description: Read the finite compatible all-mark differential, its Gaussian product and relative retract, then compare multispectator height transport with the smaller actual image on which height homotopy descends.

stages.label: Actual pair comparisons and physical Wilson sewing
stages.description: Read the arbitrary ordinary-pair comparison on its original ambient output tests, then the controlled finite Wilson assembly. Keep the integral current chains, coefficient defects and unfinished continuous protected bridge distinct.

stages.label: Whole roots and controlled mixed words
stages.description: Read the fixed-root balanced contraction and actual profile transport, then the whole-word image and Laurent constructions. Check the raw-cell source and zero-jet interface before passing to a common collision completion.

readingPaths.title: Where changing the domain changes the theorem
readingPaths.summary: Read the positive construction beside its exact obstruction or remaining comparison. The sequence is editorial and asserts no additional mathematical dependency.

stages.label: Finite recognition and source size
stages.description: Full-recipient all-arity theorems coexist with delayed failure of weaker truncated tests. Current contact modules likewise depend on their actual coefficient and support domains.

stages.label: Different defects on different completed carriers
stages.description: Compare the uncompleted coefficient-dual class, the integral current-unit equivalence, the regular-energy raw-cell obstruction and the Laurent zero-jet obstruction. Each statement retains its own source, topology and allowed maps.

stages.label: The remaining physical comparison
stages.description: Return to physical extension selection, the full normal source, endpoint grafting and marked/composite height descent. Then inspect unrestricted regular supported sewing and the common collision completion, after their finite positive comparisons.

readingPaths.title: From a computed source to the genuine action question
readingPaths.summary: One and two exterior generators exhibit the first source cells. Finite-rank interpolation gives the ordinary mapping space for every finite number of generators. Genuine Heisenberg actions also have an independent boundary leg and a scalar loop detector.

stages.label: The complete one-generator source space and the actual polynomial map
stages.description: For every ordinary algebraic, possibly unbounded dg vertex target \(B\), the degree-one exterior source satisfies \(\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(\Lambda(\epsilon),B)\simeq Z^1((B\otimes\Omega_\bullet)^{hT})\). Its components are \(H^1(B^{hT})\), and its based \(n\)-th homotopy group is \(H^{1-n}(B^{hT})\). The previously constructed polynomial map \(\nu\) is itself an equivalence for target \(\Lambda(\epsilon)\), giving \(\mathbb C^2_{\rm disc}\times K(\mathbb C,1)\). Its original composition law is retained: \((\lambda,\beta,\omega)\star(\lambda',\beta',\omega')=(\lambda\lambda',\lambda'\beta+\beta',\lambda'\omega+\omega')\), with the rightmost map applied first. The quartet comparison retains its separate strict-roof identification and ghost-model cohomology premises; the vanishing scalar singular-product detector retains its own scope. The source calculation does not identify the genuine Heisenberg actor map \(q_B\).

stages.label: One exterior generator is computed in every odd degree
stages.description: Let \(d\) be any odd integer, including a negative one, and let \(\Lambda(\epsilon_d)\) have \(|\epsilon_d|=d\) and \(d\epsilon_d=T\epsilon_d=0\). For every ordinary algebraic dg vertex algebra \(B\), unbounded in either direction if desired, \[\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(\Lambda(\epsilon_d),B)\simeq Z^d(B^{hT}\otimes\Omega_\bullet).\] Hence \(\pi_0=H^d(B^{hT})\) and \(\pi_n=H^{d-n}(B^{hT})\) at every basepoint. Here \((B^{hT})^j=B^j\oplus B^{j-1}\), with differential \((\partial b,Tb-\partial b')\). No connectivity, commutativity or target arity grading is assumed.

stages.label: Finite exterior sources have detected components and loops
stages.description: For \(A_r=\Lambda(\epsilon_1,\ldots,\epsilon_r)\), finite \(r\ge1\), all generators in degree one with \(d=T=0\), let \(B\) be a commutative dg vertex algebra strictly concentrated in nonnegative degrees. Put \(M_B=Z^1((B\otimes\Omega_\bullet)^{hT})\) and \(H_B=Z^0(B)\cap\ker T\). The actual map \[M_B^r\times(H_B)_{\rm disc}^{\binom r2}\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(A_r,B)\] has a natural homotopy left inverse. For \(B=\mathbb C\), its detected components are \(V^*\oplus\Lambda^2V^*\) and loops are \(V^*\), where \(V\) is spanned by the exterior generators. Alternation and basis changes agree with those invariants. The theorem gives a retract, not exhaustion of the full mapping space.

stages.label: The scalar binary \(\mathrm{T2}\) family now exhausts its mapping space
stages.description: The earlier derived enveloping adjunction and actual retraction exhibit an additive \(\mathbb C^3_{\rm disc}\times K(\mathbb C^2,1)\) factor for the scalar mapping space from two degree-one exterior generators. The later ordinary logarithmic quotient and strict interpolation identify the named comparison on the full derived mapping space: the same \(\mathrm{T2}\) factor now exhausts it, so the former complementary fibre is contractible. The earlier formal positive-arity conformal cochain calculation alone did not give that comparison; the actual ordinary quotient tower supplies it.

stages.label: Every genuine loop detector has scalar image
stages.description: At every point \(\alpha\) of the genuine unit fibre \(\mathscr F_A(B)\), with its specified unit homotopy retained, the state-complex loop detector has exactly \(\operatorname{im}\chi_\alpha=\mathbb C\,\mathrm{id}_{U(A)}\). The actual loops \(\epsilon\mapsto\epsilon+\mu\,ds\) give an additive central section, compatible with basepoint transport, and an isomorphism of groups \[\pi_1(\mathscr F_A(B),\alpha)\cong\mathbb C_{\mathrm{add}}\times\ker\chi_\alpha.\] Every genuine component has abelian fundamental group, so \(\ker\chi_\alpha\) is abelian at every point. Its vanishing remains open. At the displayed \(q_B\) points, this scalar factor already comes from the source. stages.description: Every closed invariant subspace of a finite product of the specified positive recipients has a dense complete Fréchet space of vectors entire for the energy action. Its topology is defined using the actual Gaussian-growth final or spectral strong topology. Gaussian Fourier smoothing and the local meromorphic germs are actual continuous operations. Every continuous linear Virasoro morphism preserves these cores with one uniform energy shift, independently of the finite-product presentation.

stages.label: The functorial positive core is not preserved by collision
stages.description: The actual primary binary collision lies outside the positive entire-vector cores even after every finite complex energy propagation, for the canonical spectral measure and the explicitly admitted alternative measures. Gaussian smoothing changes that operation and is not a Virasoro intertwiner. Separate actual weak-meromorphic and vacuum graph-dual examples also prevent the unchanged ordinary-energy smoothing construction on those factors.

stages.label: Every finite positive radial comb has its natural output range
stages.description: For every fixed finite number \(d\ge2\) of positive inputs, the actual radial comb exists on the logarithmic cover of \(0<|a_2|<\cdots<|a_d|\) in every strict output stage \(s<-\log|a_d|\). Each compact coordinate set admits one finite Hilbert input stage with a Hilbert–Schmidt bound uniform in all original positive labels and locally uniform in charge. The complete entangled source is \(\widehat\bigotimes_{i=1}^d{}_{\pi}\mathscr E_{p_i}\). All internal and final labels and all descendant levels are uncut, with normally convergent actual cutoffs and exact mark \(2^{(d-1)/4}\sqrt{\prod_v C_0}\).

stages.label: Three positive inputs have an actual vacuum-output sewing
stages.description: For fixed positive labels \(A,B,C\), the fixed-\(C\) positive point vertex followed by the coefficient-one vacuum cap defines \(\Theta_z:\mathscr E_A\widehat\otimes_\pi\mathscr E_B\widehat\otimes_\pi\mathscr E_C\to G'_b\) on the logarithmic cover of \(0<|z|<1/2\). It is holomorphic with locally common finite input stages, normally convergent intermediate and vacuum expansions, and the full rational Ward identities on all entangled inputs. All continuous linear Ward maps from this source to \(G'_b\) form exactly \(\mathbb C\Theta_z\). Its single positive binary mark is \(2^{1/4}\sqrt{C_0(A,B,C)}\).

stages.label: The common three-input carrier represents the vacuum target
stages.description: Fix a lift \(w=\log z\) with \(0<|z|<1/2\). The positive sewing \(Q_z\) and vacuum map \(\Theta_z\) formed at this lift have the complete invariant joint image closure \(R_z^{+,V}=\overline{(Q_z,\Theta_z)(E_{ABC})}\) in the product of their original strong-dual recipients. The vacuum projection induces \(\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Vir,cont}}(R_z^{+,V},G'_b)\cong\operatorname{Ward}^{G'}_{ABC}(z)=\mathbb C\Theta_z\). A closed finite positive-product recipient has a continuous inverse to \(L_0\) and no nonzero continuous Virasoro map to \(G'_b\); its positive component alone cannot represent this nonzero vacuum output. The exact quotient source maps continuously, injectively and densely into the joint closure.

stages.label: The three-input vacuum output reaches the full real interior
stages.description: Choose \(\log z\) and \(\log(1-z)\) real on \(0<z<1\). With these branches the three-positive-input vacuum map extends to the complex lens \(\mathcal L=\{|z|<1,\ |1-z|<1\}\), which contains every real \(0<z<1\). An actual Möbius transport supplies the fixed Hilbert-dual realization \(V_\sigma'\), locally common finite input stages and the unchanged graph dual. Its phase \(e^{-i\pi(h_A+h_C)}\) preserves the primary coefficient \(2^{1/4}\sqrt{C_0(A,B,C)}z^{h_C-h_A-h_B}(1-z)^{h_A-h_B-h_C}\). The full Ward identities, the one-dimensional vacuum-target classification and the joint-carrier projection hold throughout this lens.

stages.label: Independent finite trees have coherent actual comparisons
stages.description: Every finite positive planar binary tree has an independently constructed normal sewing corner with full entangled Hilbert bounds and uncut spectra. Each elementary rotation is identified on an actual common sewing domain by the normalized positive-affine four-point unitary. The square and pentagon identities make every finite reassociation path depend only on its endpoints. The resulting unitary identifies the continuation of each independent germ with the radial comb on its logarithmic radial domain; a noncomb raw series is asserted only on its own connected normal sewing domains.

stages.label: Finite sewings have complete Ward recipients and quotient sources
stages.description: Every admitted finite positive sewing and its identified continuation satisfies the full rational Ward identities on the complete entangled source. Its tree-independent kernel defines a complete Fréchet quotient, continuously and densely injected into the complete invariant image closure. Every admitted intermediate forest gives a continuous open quotient sewing, and finite successive quotient sewings agree. This uses actual packets at the stages received by their parent vertices. Representing a general continuous linear composite Ward map still requires both kernel annihilation and continuity in the topology induced from the recipient, not merely the finer quotient-source topology.

stages.label: One vacuum input is controlled in every finite word
stages.description: With the original graph source \(G\) and any fixed finite number \(r\ge1\) of positive inputs, the full entangled graph-array source is its completed projective tensor source. A nonfirst vacuum admits every strict natural output exponent \(s<-\log|a_{r+1}|\) in the actual forward comb. A first vacuum is independently realized by reflection into \(Z[-b]\) for every fixed \(b>\log2\) on the normalized real interior. Every mixed tree has its own normal corner, full rational Ward covariance and coherent comparisons induced by the pruned positive tree. Vacuum insertion has coefficient one, including the actual left translation. Mixed and pruned-positive image closures agree in the same ambient topology, while the corresponding positive-to-mixed source map is asserted only to be a continuous injection.

stages.label: Original spectral inputs can be retained through finite sewing
stages.description: Arbitrary positive original spectral measures in standard separable realizations, with measurable separable Hilbert multiplicities, admit bounded holomorphic finite-word sewing with the logarithms and strict output bounds of the corresponding fixed-label sewings. The operators act on the full entangled entire-energy Hilbert-array source. Every original spectral variable remains an output multiplicity; only new internal and final labels use the canonical measure. The fixed-label comparisons, full Ward identities and finite coherence survive direct integration, including one vacuum input. Cutoffs converge on each input locally uniformly: raw contractions are used on their own normal domains, and constant comparison operators transport comb approximants elsewhere. No global Hilbert–Schmidt bound is claimed over an atomless original measure.

stages.label: The remaining comparison is an operation-compatible input category
stages.description: At 13:50 this address recorded the intrinsic-source assignment and composite-operation questions together. There is a complete dense intrinsic common source on the admitted finite-product recipient category, with all ordinary continuous linear Virasoro morphisms and exact recovery of the original positive and vacuum source topologies. Actual collision still leaves that positive core. The remaining task is an admissible-source description of actual composite binary operations, with sewing-kernel annihilation, recipient-image continuity, product units and the actual sewn reassociation maps. General sources can be nonmetrizable and nonnuclear; the earlier Fréchet quotient argument does not automatically apply.

stages.label: Every fixed finite positive word has a rooted vacuum output
stages.description: The specified rooted channel of every fixed finite positive word has an actual multiplicity-valued vacuum graph-dual output, with \(d-2\) positive vertices and \(d-3\) uncut internal spectra. It is nonzero at every real ordered configuration. Its construction uses canonical every-fibre kernels, annular Hilbert–Schmidt composition and actual Möbius transport, without evaluating arbitrary spectral \(L^2\) classes at fixed labels.

stages.label: Regular modes separate the original vacuum tensor sources
stages.description: Geometric polynomial separators and the graph-source Gaussian estimate isolate every regular mode \(L_j\), \(j\ge-1\), at each factor of the literal positive/vacuum projective source, including \(G\widehat\otimes_\pi G\). Source projections and positive-mode dual functionals detect a finite-bidegree component of a nonzero invariant kernel.

stages.label: Mixed and vacuum binary maps are injective on their full sources
stages.description: The actual positive/vacuum and vacuum/vacuum binary maps are injective on their specified completed projective sources. The proof applies regular-mode separation to the actual continuous linear maps. The coefficient-one left unit retains its translation and the proved loss in output range.

stages.label: Actual recipient filters give a complete dense regular domain
stages.description: Closed invariant subspaces of finite products of the admitted positive Gaussian, positive spectral, original meromorphic and vacuum graph-dual recipients have a complete dense intrinsic rapid-mode domain. The actual Fourier-binomial and superexponential filters fix the vacuum highest vector, cut off levels above the specified finite order and converge pointwise to the identity in the original topologies.

stages.label: The intrinsic common input functor recovers the exact elementary topologies
stages.description: For each admitted recipient, intersect the rapid regular domain with the inverse images of the original source spaces under every continuous Virasoro map to elementary positive and vacuum templates. The closed product graph is complete and Hausdorff, precomposition is functorial, and the actual filters prove density. Local meromorphic Virasoro germs act through absolutely convergent full mode-word series with the original central cocycle. The topology agrees exactly with the original positive entire-energy sources and with \(M\widehat\otimes_\pi G\) on vacuum multiplicity objects.

stages.label: The common source retains the actual collision exclusion
stages.description: Actual primary collision leaves the positive entire-energy core even after finite energy propagation. Because the common input functor recovers that exact topology, its positive projection is a template test excluding the collision value. The complete dense functor therefore does not itself make that actual operation preserve its assigned sources.

readingPaths.title: Keep the current before taking its trace
readingPaths.summary: Follow the original current and normalization data through finite source/word domains, paired-width moments and the actual graph-source projected zero. Keep the original compact exit, old cylinder and fixed lower attachment distinct from these finite calculations.

stages.label: Incoming relations and an independent graph realization
stages.description: For the chosen labelled cubic matching with two occurrences of root \(U\) and one of root \(V\), the incoming relation cylinder descends to the actual current image with its full source differential. The independent graph-current and central-bar realization has actual Wick operations and a square-zero differential before trace. The fixed-branch polynomial-to-supported normal comparison supplies its ordered cubic source inverse; these constructions retain the individual branches and central outputs.

stages.label: All sixteen histories on the polynomial-Thom carrier
stages.description: Complete root-and-central collar matrices construct all sixteen cubic histories on the specified polynomial-Thom graph-first carrier. The resulting untraced transferred operation has its own source chain equation. Finite prisms for all subsets of the six scalar contact coordinates retain their face identities, normal connections, support and excess factors. Scalar repeated-root vanishing holds on its stated exterior-degree-zero domain. The full finite polynomial contact matrix now supplies exact normalization on a common named q stage. Coefficientwise agreement with the normalized mixed presentation requires the same native matrix, frames and retained contraction in the same order; the compact polynomial-q and unreduced current-normal sources are not identified by their unit scalars.

stages.label: Actual first-order source and contact prisms
stages.description: On the evaluated graph-marked scalar root and finite-jet domain, the native first residue equals its independent counterpart. The first-order source comparison and its full cone retain both source rows and the localization and coordinate endpoint terms. The specified first-contact primitive and radial lower-section regularizations have actual open, proper-pair and point current limits. On the protected empty-matching restriction of the literal mixed carrier, the original fixed-order first source coefficient is now evaluated as \(S_1=0\). Its generally nonzero classical path and first path coefficient under the old endpoint remain separate from that projection value.

stages.label: A nonzero fourth-order current can have zero trace
stages.description: The original one-field normal collar has controlled current limits on the anchored three-covariance word. Its displayed bare compact-partner \(\alpha\) kernel has a strictly positive fourth moment and an untraced point current of exact order four, with coefficient \(M/2\), although its proper central-base trace is zero. Weighted Green-leg \(\alpha\) terms retain a nonzero commutator correction; their vanishing cannot be inferred from the unweighted case.

stages.label: The first transverse normal family is realized
stages.description: Finite \(q\)-smooth strong-current families admit the actual finite normal relation projection, compatible with the full differential and both normal Weyl actions. On the first ordered transverse family \(u_v\otimes v_w\), every exterior row, finite jet and \(q\)-independent branch face satisfies the normalized canonical-current comparison.

stages.label: One supported field has its own current limit
stages.description: Replacing one field by its signed supported section, with its matching unweighted radial primitive and four remaining top Thom fields, gives the stated limits in all three pair positions. The \(\eta\) and \(s\) limits and the \(g\) rows vanish, while the \(c_t\alpha\) point order is at most \(4+J+q\). The displayed bare supported-prefix moment obeys \(M_{\mathrm{sp}}>M_{\mathrm{sm}}>0\), has coefficient \(M_{\mathrm{sp}}/2\) and exact order four, and retains zero proper central trace at its declared coefficient scope. A separate polynomial-weighted extension covers this history in all three pair positions, retaining the weight before Green. Its supported point-order bound is \(4+J+q-d\); the weighted Green anchor can be nonzero, and the unweighted zero-trace assertion is not transferred to it.

stages.label: The supported partner has every finite fresh-jet row
stages.description: The canonical supported-partner projection is an actual current map in all four exterior rows and every finite incoming fresh-normal degree on its declared supported carrier. It retains every finite old-root, graph-slot and primitive-slot jet, the full coefficient boundary and the specified central, root and frame squares. The earlier fresh-degree-zero matrix remains its exact restriction: its zero-jet value is nonzero and its first-root Taylor correction contains both \(1/3\) and \(-1/6\). Fresh incoming powers have their own finite matrix and are not identified with outgoing contact jets.

stages.label: One fully supported earlier pair is an actual single action
stages.description: For the ordered word \(a_1\,a_2\,u_3\,v_4\,v_5\,v_6\), the fully supported earlier pair factors through the prescribed single root action on the independent \((U,t)\) coefficient domain. The \(\eta\) and \(s\) limits and \(g\) rows vanish, and the \(c_t\alpha\) point order is at most \(4+J+q\). The exhibited bare fourth moment is strictly negative, with coefficient \(M/2\) and exact order four; its proper central-base trace vanishes on the stated restricted coefficient domain. The distinct word \(a_1a_2a_3u_4v_5v_6\) also has its own independently scaled triangular current domain and fourth-order collar limit. Both of these exact histories admit the stated polynomial-weighted primitive extension; neither result defines a second fully supported repeated-root pair by formal iteration.

stages.label: A nonzero first augmented edge agrees in the prescribed order
stages.description: The actual first augmented section edge is constructed with all designated raw pair jets, the complete central Taylor correction, its normal primitive and both prism vertex legs. Native and independent section edges agree and are nonzero when the order and contraction agree. Reversing the order retains an intersection projector and a source term; those terms cannot be discarded before identifying the fixed lower comparison. The same-order equality extends to the complete first augmented section on the marked-forward graph-current carrier, including all classical internal-differential correction rows. The actual order-prism contribution and the fixed lower cochain remain when the orders differ.

stages.label: The bounded native matrix is fixed; later histories remain
stages.description: The actual relative-generator, tangent and physical-jet comparison is supplied on the declared retained-U stage, with a separate old-U/new-V current matrix. Direct evaluation gives the compared scalar unit \(\kappa_{\mathrm{unit}}=1\), and the full finite polynomial matrix fixes the named unreduced and compared stages. The protected empty-history mixed source has its original fixed-order \(S_1=0\). The remaining task is to extend the required native maps and full fixed projections to every later generated homotopy output, with their actual order/cone prisms, and to supply the independent quadratic residue primitive. The original compact output equality, first path under the old endpoint and fixed lower marking are not consequences of these bounded results.

stages.label: The supported-partner matrix includes every finite fresh jet
stages.description: The supported-partner map \(\mathcal R_q=\rho_q^{-1}g_q^{\mathrm{nat}}(C\,\cdot)\), \(C=(4\pi^2)^{-1}\), is evaluated on every finite fresh incoming \(\sigma\) degree and all four contact-exterior rows of its actual supported carrier. The fresh power contributes \((-t(\partial_x-\zeta))^\gamma\) in the finite polynomial integral, with outgoing contact jet \(\zeta\); the physical incoming variable \(S=\sigma-\alpha\) instead contributes \((-\alpha-t(\partial_x-\zeta))^\gamma\). The full coefficient boundary, finite-stage bounds and specified normal, coordinate and old-face squares remain. The top exterior row kills positive incoming fresh degree instead of turning it into an outgoing contact jet.

stages.label: Fourth-order point currents have explicit central prisms
stages.description: The original full central de Rham contraction gives finite primitives and branch comparisons for the available trace-zero point currents of total derivative order at most four. In six central relative directions its homogeneous denominator is \(n+6-k\). A displayed fourth-order witness with coefficient \(M/2\) has primitive coefficient \(M/4\). Every product of five anchored contractions vanishes; a specified fourfold product is nonzero with coefficient \(-1/12\), so the fourth incidence term is retained. Nonclosed coefficients retain their full differential.

stages.label: A triangular supported history has an actual current limit
stages.description: The word \(a_1a_2a_3u_4v_5v_6\), with one fully supported pair followed by a supported-field/primitive pair, has a complete native auxiliary limit for three independent supported-field scales at fixed positive collar scale, followed by its collar limit. On the protected coefficient domain the \(\eta,s\) and scalar primitive rows vanish; the supported \(c_t\alpha\) row has point order at most \(4+J+q\). Its displayed bare fourth moment is strictly negative, has coefficient \(M_\triangle/2\), and proves exact order four for that row. Its restricted proper central trace is zero, while the direct triangle residue \((8\pi^2)^{-1}D_{Uv}(c_Uc_v)\) remains in the full boundary.

stages.label: Compact normalization and polynomial injectivity are established
stages.description: The full shear Hom cochain on the normalized two-input cell is transported by \(C^{-2}\), including its dual Koszul-frame terms. At each positive scale, the declared finite holomorphic polynomial Thom columns are linearly independent; the reduced evaluation remains injective with contact delta jets and independent central holomorphic forms retained. The further equality between the original compact output and that reduced evaluation is not established. Supplying that literal equality on the unit would make the compact calibration argument yield the pure reduced unit.

stages.label: The complete first augmented sections agree in the same order
stages.description: On the actual finite graph-current carrier, including every internal-differential correction row of the classical section, the first native contact preserves the marked old central factors before projection. The prescribed homotopy then has zero contact and face defects on this carrier. Consequently \(g_N(1+D_Nh_N)^{-1}\delta_Nf_N=\widehat\delta_{I,1}^{\,g}\) and \(s_{N,1}=s_{I,1}\) for the same augmented order and contraction. The sections can be nonzero. A different order retains its actual prism and both source and target terms.

stages.label: Matched pair scales give a zero summed native limit
stages.description: For the bare zero-jet four-supported-field family with widths \((r,r;s,s)\), individual labelled anchors have ratio-dependent order-two point currents. After the four anchors are transported to common physical central coordinates, all their quadratic point polynomials cancel with the original equal halves. The complete summed native family tends to zero uniformly in every ratio path, with remainder \(O(m(1+|\log m|))\), \(m=\max(r,s)\). This is a limit statement, not an assertion that the positive-scale family is identically zero.

stages.label: The actual native relative contact has its full jet matrix
stages.description: The original relative physical differential-module generator identifies the native contact, with source jets sent to \(T_v+S\) and \(T_w+P-S\). Its full tangent comparison retains every exterior and de Rham row. After the contact split the original physical jets are \(\sigma\) and \(\alpha+\beta-\sigma\). Composing this source map with the transverse and finite-fresh supported matrices gives the actual first selected-pair current comparison after a retained \(U\)-contact, including finite jets, coefficient differentials and the named old two-anchor faces.

stages.label: The compared native unit is exactly one
stages.description: Direct evaluation of the native relative generator, tangent matrix and signed normal projection gives the pure retained unit \(C_q\,1_U1_x1_q\), with \(C_q=C\), followed by \(g_q^{\mathrm{nat}}(C_q)=c_q\). In the named normalized incoming and root/central bases, the chain is \(C^2 1_v1_w\mapsto C^2C_q1_U1_x1_q\mapsto C^21_U1_xc_q\), so \(\kappa_{\mathrm{unit}}=1\) in the compared basis. The original root constant, central density, contact current and all fibre and anchor factors remain separately typed.

stages.label: The native-to-supported comparison keeps a nonzero unit homotopy
stages.description: On the specified repeated-\(U\) current stage, the actual closed native contact has comparison primitive \(\mathcal K_j=h_qI_qL_j\), with \(\partial\mathcal K_j=(1-j_q^{\mathrm{nat}}g_q^{\mathrm{nat}})I_qL_j\). Including the odd contact suspension, this primitive has ordinary Hom degree zero. Its unit value is \(h_q(C_q)=U_0(q)\ne0\), with \(D U_0(q)=C_q+t_1t_2c_q\). The signed supported section is \(-t_1t_2c_q\); zero polynomial division on the unit is a different comparison.

stages.label: An open extension has exact descent and endpoint tests
stages.description: Given actual old localization maps and an enlarged ambient primitive with the exact old restriction, the relative mapping cylinder has explicit rows preserving both old maps. Pullback to the enlarged current carrier requires an actual continuous graded retraction or a separate descent argument. Let \(e:F\twoheadrightarrow D_{\mathrm{cur}}\) be the cochain evaluation, assume \(q\Lambda_F\) already factors through \(e\), and require \(U_F=q\Lambda_F-\partial W_F\). Then simultaneous descent is exactly \(W_F(\ker e)=0\) in the original full-intersection quotient, with the actual quotient-topology bounds. For an independently supplied endpoint \(u_*:D\to O_Z[-1]\) satisfying \(\partial u_*=qc\) and \(u_*i=u_L\), and an actual graded extension \(\widetilde W_L\) of \(w_L\) on this same enlarged carrier with the required finite bounds, the remaining extension class is \([q\Lambda-u_*-\partial\widetilde W_L]\in H^{-1}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{cont}}(D/L,O_Z)\). These premises do not supply the original maps' enlarged-domain identification or evaluate that class.

stages.label: Four independent widths can change the summed native current
stages.description: The complete zero-jet native four-field sum has a full point-current limit at each fixed positive four-width ratio. In physical coordinates it is \([A D_{U,x_1}+B D_{U,x_2}+(B-A)D_{x_1,x_2}/2]\Delta\). Equal widths give zero. A single fixed positive choice \((\delta\epsilon,\epsilon;\delta\epsilon,\delta\epsilon)\) gives \((J_\delta/16)[D_{U,x_1}-D_{x_1,x_2}/2]\Delta\), with \(J_\delta\ge1/(2\pi^2)\). One fixed compact test separates these limits. Thus this specified regularization class has no extension independent of all four widths.

stages.label: The point differences have primitives in the original central carrier
stages.description: The available bare order-two point-current differences have zero proper central trace and explicit order-one primitives under the original contraction with denominator \(n+4-k\). The physical cross-central term has central degree two and therefore contributes the required extra factor \(1/2\) in that primitive. Actual anchor shears give two-anchor prisms and triangle coherence; three contractions vanish at this order. The cancelling paired-scale anchor vector has its direct branch filling with the original \((-1)^q\) totalization sign.

stages.label: A chosen paired-scale history has zero iterated limit
stages.description: For \(a_1a_2a_3a_4u_5v_6\), the first four supported fields unjetted, paired widths \((r,r;s,s)\) tend to zero at each fixed positive collar scale before the collar limit. The complete native sum is zero on the protected \(\eta_t,s_{t,j},c_t\) domain. Finite coefficient, primitive, sixth-field and remaining-kernel jets are admitted. An external-current description turns the last pair into a smooth parameter test for the established paired-scale bound, with all central and elliptic outputs retained.

stages.label: Polynomial weights extend the three specified primitive histories
stages.description: Finite holomorphic weights on the full primitive before Green are allowed in the supported-prefix, earlier-pair-prefix and triangular histories, with at most one fully supported pair. For homogeneous degree \(d\ge1\), the new Green term is \(Q_{P,\epsilon}=A_PF_{d,\epsilon}\), where \(F_{d,\epsilon}(s)=-s^{-d-1}\int_0^s r^{d-1}b_\epsilon(r)\,dr\); its leading singular coefficient is \(C/d\), with no degree-two resonance. After the independent auxiliary limits and then the collar limit, \(\eta,s\) and scalar rows vanish, while the supported alpha rows have order at most \(4+J+q-d\). For the displayed linear weight, both separate bare active anchors have a negative cubic moment \(M\), point coefficient \(-M/2\), exact order three and nonzero proper active-central pushforward.

stages.label: Coefficient extension requires the actual same-tuple module maps
stages.description: For prescribed old maps that commute with restriction and are graded-linear over smooth base Dolbeault forms on the same retained tuple, the explicit extension \(E_rz=(-1)^rM_Uz_V-(-1)^rM_Vz_U-M_UM_Vz_0\) descends to the original quotient \(O_Z\), preserves old restrictions and commutes with the full Hom differential. It retains both proper-root defects and finite normal moments. An actual smooth-current overlap disproves a proposed rule that would kill the new exterior-pattern presentation while fixing its equal smooth-multiplier presentation. The original independently prescribed localization maps have not been identified with the required module maps.

stages.label: Every finite polynomial contact column has the exact normalization
stages.description: On the complete finite independent-\(q\) polynomial, exterior and jet complex, the actual forward maps obey \(g_q^{\mathrm{nat}}I_q=\rho_qp_q\), including the independent coefficient differential. The full physical-jet and exterior Taylor matrix therefore fixes both the unreduced contact \(C^2b_jI_qL_j\) and its compared value \(C^2b_j\rho_qp_qL_j\). With the same native matrix, q recipient, labelled frames and retained contraction in the same order, the polynomial and normalized mixed presentations agree coefficientwise, including every finite coefficient of their transferred source. Different sections retain their radial bridge, and different homotopy orders retain their actual prism.

stages.label: The other-root sector has an actual four-row current matrix
stages.description: After an old \(U\)-contact, a selected \(V\)-contact with protected \(\mu(U-V)\) has its actual native q-normal comparison on the new h-supported triangle carrier. The old-root moment transfer, all four exterior rows, every finite fresh jet, full coefficient differential and named old faces are retained. The companion ordered summand is a smooth strong-current q family. In the \(\eta\) row the original direct triangle term has a zero-jet detector \(-1/(8\pi^2)\), with its full normal-jet transfer; it is not removed by the proper-pair calculation.

stages.label: The protected empty-history first source coefficient is zero
stages.description: At the empty matching, one protected \(\mu(U-V)\) coefficient makes both ordered selected homotopy inputs smooth strong-current q families. The original fixed-order full normal word is separately defined on its generated finite current stages and has zero projection on the complete selected row. On the literal normalized mixed carrier, with identity inclusion on the common unreduced retained factor, both terms of the original first source coefficient vanish: \(S_1=-g_N(\delta_N\mathsf w+\iota h_P\delta_Pf_P)=0\). The q-first comparison and fixed-order projection are evaluated separately; their order-comparison cochains are not individually declared zero.

stages.label: The original compact and lower-marked cubic attachment remains open
stages.description: The original six-field relative cubic target and its fixed lower maps remain. There are finite normal-word and genuine unit/s/jet source domains, full paired-width prefix moments and their prescribed weighted-collar composition. On the actual graph-source image, with the identical retained contraction and order, the projected polynomial-homotopy term vanishes. Completion still requires the original compact restricted square \(\gamma=Aj_qj_r-Ej_r\), the actual old-cylinder \(J_N\) on unsupported homotopy-output rows, the original normal-order prism and the remaining full branch/incidence and fixed-lower attachment comparisons. Neither a zero projection nor a nonzero trace-free current supplies the full relative Hom filler or a correction-invariant obstruction.

stages.label: Established point prefixes enter the original outer collar
stages.description: An established finite point-current prefix has an actual external-current continuation at each positive collar scale. Full forms, distributional integration by parts and the positive delta-Taylor rule retain the native signs and factors. On the full supported \(c_V\) row, the alpha term vanishes and the scalar term is \(O(\epsilon^2)\), including the stated finite holomorphic jets.

stages.label: The old cylinder keeps its actual cone and lower Hom terms
stages.description: The original normalized cone retains \(h_o^2=-t_og_o\), \(h_of_o=f_ok_o-\partial t_o\) and \(1-g_of_o=\partial k_o\). Its literal finite perturbation gives the path and double-prism coefficients with both cone columns and all lower source terms. A finite counterexample rules out replacing its individual blocks by a strict deformation retract.

stages.label: A designated field jet has a full ratio-dependent cubic moment
stages.description: One own-normal holomorphic derivative among four supported inputs with widths \((r,r;s,s)\) has a complete cubic point polynomial and physical central shear, with remainder \(O(m(1+|\log m|))\), \(m=\max(r,s)\), uniform in the ratio at the fixed stage. A rigorous finite-ratio compact witness is nonzero, and the two extreme ratio values differ on one fixed joint test.

stages.label: The two q-first eta orders have a nonzero restored-jet detector
stages.description: On the stated old-U/new-V eta cell, both complete q-first orders give \(K_\eta=(C/2)(D-D_\zeta)(c_Vc_x)\). After realizing the outgoing q jet, the residue-one \(q_2V_1\) detector equals \(C/2\). The separately transported graph-first endpoint is zero. Their comparison retains both the order-prism differential and the actual source-boundary term.

stages.label: The compact q comparison isolates the original exit residual
stages.description: On supplied common domains, \(A\delta_u-E\delta_c=\partial(AH_q\delta_u)+(Aj_q-E)\delta_c\). The actual unit primitive keeps the full three-row q homotopy, external factors and source-precomposition term. readingPaths.title: The ordinary unit across parameter ranges
readingPaths.summary: Rank one displays the original adjunction, the native ideal and the inflated-base unit. The positive-root bound extends the finite tower to every simple type at nonrational shift. Critical and rational examples test the scope of the ordinary unit and the separate torsion-image comparison.

stages.label: A model of the actual unit on every ordinary input
stages.description: Under the native hypotheses, a strict smooth right-\(R\) model \(Q\) representing \(W\) with its supplied marked native action, a semifree resolution \(F\to L\), and a genuine smooth \(K\)-injective replacement \(j:Q\otimes_R F\to J\) give the full Hom model \(\operatorname{Hom}_A(Q,J)\) of \(\Psi\Phi(L)\). The signed map \(l\mapsto(q\mapsto(-1)^{|q||l|}j(q\otimes l))\) is the actual unit for every unbounded \(L\).

stages.label: Every unbounded smooth complex has an explicit injective replacement
stages.description: An actual acyclic-monomorphism cell construction iterated through \(\omega_1\) gives a strict ordinary functor \(J\) and a natural monomorphic quasi-isomorphism \(M\to J(M)\). Every term of \(J(M)\) is injective and the whole complex is K-injective, so full \(\operatorname{Hom}_A(X,J(M))\) computes ordinary smooth derived Hom for arbitrary unbounded \(X,M\).

stages.label: The actual nonrational rank-one ideal has zero derived tensor square
stages.description: For \(B=Y_{-s}\), \(\mathfrak g=\mathfrak{sl}_2\) and \(s\notin\mathbb Q\), the actual positive-weight ideal \(I=\bigoplus_{w>0}B_w\) satisfies \(I\otimes_{U(\mathfrak{sl}_2)}^{\mathbf L}I\simeq0\), retaining both outer actions in the graded and ungraded bimodule categories.

stages.label: A derived square-zero ideal reduces every source to two inflated complexes
stages.description: Let \(B\to R\) be a split augmented dg algebra, K-flat over \(R\) on both sides, with ideal \(I\) satisfying \(I\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}I=0\). For \(F=R\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}-\), inflation \(U\), and \(J=R\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}I\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}R\), every unbounded \(L\) has a natural triangle \(U(J\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}F(L))\to L\to UF(L)\). For any exact adjunction out of \(D(B)\), its actual unit is globally invertible exactly when it is invertible on every inflated \(R\)-complex.

stages.label: The actual unit is invertible on every inflated base complex
stages.description: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), native \(k\notin\mathbb Q\) and raw affine level \(\ell=-k-2\), the actual native unit is an equivalence on every ordinary unbounded complex inflated from the full ghost quotient \(H=U(\mathfrak g[t^{-1}])\), hence from \(R=U(\mathfrak g)\). The signed unit evaluates at the vacuum to the identity under the genuine unbounded Shapiro comparison.

stages.label: Nonrational rank-one induction is fully faithful on the entire ordinary source
stages.description: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\), native \(k\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q\) and raw affine level \(\ell=-k-2\), the actual unit \(L\to\Psi\Phi L\) is an equivalence for every ordinary unbounded \(Y_k\)-module, including nonzero ghost actions. The actual realization is fully faithful with image exactly \(\operatorname{Loc}(W)\), or \(\operatorname{Loc}\{W\langle w\rangle:w\in\mathbb Z\}\) in the graded convention.

stages.label: The actual counit is the cellular approximation at nonrational rank one
stages.description: Under the same nonrational \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) native hypotheses, \(W\) and its required internal shifts are compact within the generated image. For every unrestricted smooth target \(M\), the actual counit \(\Phi\Psi M\to M\) is canonically the cellular-coreflector map \(\operatorname{Cell}_W M\to M\); it is invertible exactly on that image.

stages.label: The ordinary global unit fails at critical level
stages.description: For every nonzero simple complex \(\mathfrak g\) at affine level \(\mu=-h\), put \(E=Y_0\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{U(\mathfrak g)}\mathbb C\). The ordinary algebraic telescope \(L=\operatorname*{hocolim}_{r\ge0}E[r]\langle-r(r+3)/2\rangle\), using the lifted quadratic-jet extensions, is nonzero and has \(\Phi(L)=0\). Its actual unit is \(L\to0\) with nonzero cone \(L[1]\). This holds graded and ungraded under the stated native hypotheses.

stages.label: The ordinary unit fails at every integral affine level at most minus four
stages.description: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) at raw affine level \(-p-2\), \(p\ge2\), a telescope of perfect Verma preimages gives \(L_p\ne0\) with \(\Phi_pL_p=0\). The actual ordinary unit is \(L_p\to0\), with nonzero cone \(L_p[1]\). An infinite-projection map entirely within the generated recipient also proves that \(W_p\) is not compact there.

stages.label: Every simple type has a noncritical unit kernel at a specified level
stages.description: For every nonzero finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra \(\mathfrak g\) at raw affine level \(-2h^\vee\), an explicit affine-Weyl ascent chain gives an ordinary line telescope \(L\ne0\) with \(\Phi L=0\). Its actual unit has cone \(L[1]\ne0\). The same construction proves failure of compactness of \(W\) within its own localizing image.

stages.label: The unresolved rational levels of ordinary induction
stages.description: For every simple type at nonrational shift the ordinary source has invertible original unit under the native adjunction hypotheses. Some specified negative and critical inputs have nonzero realization kernel. The named raw rank-one \(-3\) telescope and a separate critical quadratic telescope both have invertible unit despite vanishing weight-zero base change. The all-source rational classification remains open.
